items.description: Every supported coordinate format, mixed with phone numbers, part numbers, money, dates, ratios and measurements that must not be read as coordinates.
Legacy and mixed datums: AGD66 grid (not converted, flagged), GDA94 (transformed), WGS84, and none.
notes: AGD66 truth via PROJ: EPSG:20255 -> AGD66 -> GDA94 ('AGD66 to GDA94 (4)', 1 m) -> GDA2020. The unconverted reading is ~200 m away and must carry >= 250 m uncertainty to count as honest.

items.description: Three photos: GPS with heading and error, GPS only, no GPS.
Asset register mixing lat/lon rows, MGA2020 grid rows (datum in the header) and a row with no location (asset lookup needs the network).
notes: HY-330 has no location in the table; online it needs the customer asset layer, which the corpus does not have, so it stays unresolved in both modes.

items.description: Counts by postcode and LGA, including an LGA written as 'City of ...' and a postcode with no postal area.
notes: 9726 is a PO box postcode with no ABS postal area: unresolved, not guessed.

items.description: Street and landmark addresses in prose. Needs a locator.
network_mentions: Bendigo Town Hall, 189-193 Hargreaves Street, Bendigo VIC 3550
Bendigo railway station car park, Railway Place, Bendigo
Kyneton Town Hall, Hutton Street, Kyneton VIC 3444
notes: Reference positions are OpenStreetMap features (ODbL); the bar is the nominated locator's own result, so re-baseline against it when one is chosen.

items.description: Inner-Melbourne names that each exist in other states; the cluster settles them.
Windsor and Richmond are neighbours in both Melbourne and the Hawkesbury; only the river settles which.
notes: The river's reference is a point near Windsor with 5 km tolerance; a line geometry is accepted if it passes within that distance.

items.description: A bare place name with no context: must come back ambiguous.
Bendigo suburbs, two of which exist elsewhere, plus a lake the offline gazetteer does not hold.
notes: Lake Eppalock is a reservoir about 12 km long. A single point for it is only good to about 5 km: OpenStreetMap's point and the VICNAMES register's point are 4.5 km apart. A polygon of the lake is the better answer and is accepted.

items.description: Springfield exists in five states; Ipswich settles it. Springfield Lakes is its own locality and must not collapse into Springfield.
Offsets, a buffer, a sector and a line along a named road.
network_mentions: along the Calder between Kyneton and Castlemaine
notes: The sector reach (30 km) and the Calder reference line (locality points of Kyneton, Malmsbury, Taradale, Elphinstone) are approximations: geometry type is the primary check, position is checked against the stated uncertainty.

items.description: An organisation's facility with no place name: off by default.
No places at all: people named after places, versions, money, phone numbers, and a number pair that looks like coordinates.
